paragraphs: The Freelander Si4 was introduced during the L359 generation (2006–2014) as the petrol option in the range, using Ford's 2.0-litre EcoBoost turbocharged four-cylinder engine. This is the same engine family found in a range of Ford and Volvo products of the era, offering 240PS in this application. It was the performance-oriented petrol choice alongside the diesel Td4, eD4 and SD4 variants. The Freelander was discontinued in 2014, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Ford EcoBoost engines for every Freelander Si4 on the road.

compatibility.intro: The Freelander Si4 uses the Ford EcoBoost 2.0-litre turbo petrol engine, fitted exclusively to the L359 generation. Because this engine has specific cooling and timing chain requirements, we confirm your exact specification by registration before quoting or supplying any work. This protects you from compatibility issues that can arise from assuming parts from other Freelander variants will fit.
